files.description: High-pitched, highly energetic cartoon duck voice with extreme nasality and a wet, slushy articulation. The voice is expressive and animated, maintaining surprisingly good intelligibility despite the heavy characterization.
issues: abrupt cut-off at the end of the file during the second take
minor harshness and distortion inherent to the extreme vocal fry and nasality of the character voice

notes: The speaker is consistent across the repeated takes in the single provided file. The duck-like lisp is very prominent and clear on all sibilants (e.g., 'Слушай', 'если', 'хочешь'). Intelligibility remains high for a duck voice, and the cartoon energy is excellent, though the recording ends abruptly.
